name: khr-render-fidelity-tools
description: rendering fidelity test suite and tools

scripts.build: npm run build:dspbr-pt && npm run build:gltf-sample-renderer && tsc && rollup -c
scripts.prepare: npm run fetch:filament && npm run fetch:model-viewer && node scripts/fetch-renderers.js
scripts.build:gltf-sample-renderer: cd glTF-Sample-Renderer && npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run build
scripts.build:dspbr-pt: cd dspbr-pt && node .yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.0.cjs install && node .yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.0.cjs workspace dspbr-pt run build
scripts.clean: rimraf dist lib test/results test/renderers/filament/cmgen test/renderers/filament/cmgen.exe test/renderers/filament/cmgen.version test/renderers/filament/cmgen-src test/renderers/filament/ktx test/renderers/filament/runtime test/renderers/model-viewer/runtime
